page_title: CAD 1-1 ALM | Cadiz CF v Almeria 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz) sees a card red coloured card.
90+10' Referee Victor Garcia seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz).

90+10' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz), but referee Victor Garcia must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+9' The attendance for today's match is 18653.
90+5' 1 - 1 Goal! Kaiky (Almeria) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the right post. It's 1:1.
90+3' Fali (Cadiz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Largie Ramazani (Almeria) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) comes onto the pitch so that Ruben Alcaraz can be given a rest.
89' Sergio has decided to substitute Roger Marti and he is replaced by Fede San Emeterio (Cadiz).
89' It's time for a substitution. Leo Baptistao (Almeria) comes on in place of Luis Suarez.
87' The resulting free kick from Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
86' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) brings an opponent down and Victor Garcia interrupts the game. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Cadiz CF.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ivan Alejo leaves the pitch and Lucas Pires (Cadiz) comes on.
84' Victor Garcia blows his whistle as Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
81' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

81' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
76' A cooling break is underway.
74' Almeria are ruled offside.
73' Vicente Moreno has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Robertone (Almeria) replacing Adrian Embarba.
73' Here comes a substitution. Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) is brought on as a substitute for Dion Lopy.
72' Luis Suarez (Almeria) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
69' It is time for a substitution. Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) is on for Darwin Machis.
69' Sergio decides to make a substitution. Chris Ramos will be replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
68' Roger Marti (Cadiz) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Luis Maximiano is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
64' Luis Suarez (Almeria) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the right post.
64' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Almeria are awarded a free kick.
61' Victor Garcia sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
61' The Cadiz CF players halt their celebrations as referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
59' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Gonzalo Escalante is the provider as he slips the ball to Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:0.
58' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. It's a free kick to Cadiz CF, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
58' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

58' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee blows his whistle, Cadiz CF are awarded a corner kick.
56' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
52' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Darwin Machis (Cadiz).
52' Vicente Moreno is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Sergio Arribas will be replaced by Kaiky (Almeria).
50' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) sees a yellow card in the hand of Victor Garcia. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) is sent from the pitch.
46' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
46' Vicente Moreno makes a switch. Largie Ramazani is coming on in place of Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Corner kick. Darwin Machis (Cadiz) is ready to send the ball into the box.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
42' Luis Maximiano comes off his line to intercept the corner from Darwin Machis (Cadiz).
38' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) takes the corner.
36' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
35' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. Cadiz CF win a corner kick.
31' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
30' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the right post.
29' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Adrian Embarba (Almeria). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

26' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Luis Maximiano pulls off an easy save.

26' The cross into the penalty area from Darwin Machis (Cadiz) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
22' Dangerous play by Dion Lopy (Almeria). Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
17' Roger Marti (Cadiz) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.
16' Luis Suarez (Almeria) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Luis Maximiano comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' Arnau Puigmal (Almeria) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
9' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
4' Almeria failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Almeria will kick-off.
Victor Garcia was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
